name: Пастки: усунення захисника та розрахунок
description: In this lesson, it's important to look beyond the immediate moves. You can capture a defender in two ways to win material, but careful calculation shows that only one way is truly effective.

examples.pgn: {[%cal Re5d7,Gc5f2] [#]} 1. Rxd7 $1 Qxf2 2. Rxg7+ Kxg7 3. Bxf2 *
examples.text:
With 1.Nxd7 and 1.Rxd7, White captures the defender of the queen on c5. If Black recaptures on d7, White simply captures the queen, achieving the goal. However, Black can also first capture the queen on f2 and then recapture on d7. This is a clever intermediate move by Black, but White has a smart reply as well!

1.Rxd7! Qxf2 and now White does not recapture on f2 but instead saves the rook with an intermediate check: 2.Rxg7+! Kxg7 3.Bxf2. White remains a piece up!

In the case of 1.Nxd7 (red arrow) 1...Qxf2, White has no useful intermediate move. 2.Nf6+ does not save the knight, as Black has 2...Nxf6. If White captures the queen (2.Bxf2), Black captures the knight on d7, and the material is balanced again.

puzzles.pgn: {[%cal Gc4f7] [#]} {Q=1} 1... Rxd2 ! (1... Nxd2? 2. Qxf7 Bxf7 3. Rxd2) 2. Qxf7 {Q=2} Rxg2+ 3. Kxg2 Bxf7 *
texts: Choose the right capture. Try to calculate accurately and deeply with forcing moves.
